name: bandit.r033_registered_fire_samelevel_dedup_mcw
description: R-033 maintained-fire route v2. Native ignition creates the only fire field at reachable same-level source [3371,996,0]; the persistent fd_fire source is then read at two authoritative staffed-observer cadences to prove create-then-dedup.

proof_gates.label: R-033 maintained fire reaches one current source-bound live session

steps.label: operate_r033_registered_fire_samelevel_dedup
steps.objective: Bind the singleton idle site/member 18 and the exact brazier/log source. Use only the currently advertised native actions to ignite the brazier, verify native fd_fire at the source, then wait through the first five-minute cadence for the source-bound callback and created durable lead. Leave the fire maintained and wait through the next cadence; retain the same lead identity and unchanged/dedup receipt.
proof_targets: singleton registered idle site and observer identity
native ignition result correlated with f_brazier and fd_fire at [3374,983,0]
first source-bound fire scan and accepted observer callback/created lead
second source-bound fire scan and unchanged lead identity/dedup
sound/smoke absence and exact lead count/hash at both boundaries
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen bounded waits
invariants: registration and all staged items are zero-credit setup
fire is created and maintained through native player interaction
do not treat unrelated presentation as callback evidence

evidence_contract.claim: one source-bound R-033 run supplies only independently observed native fire-to-created-lead and same-source dedup facts
evidence_contract.failure_rule: missing native ignition, source binding, singleton observer identity, first callback, or identity-changing second read leaves the affected claim unproved
